rules.scope: Node spans as defined by the yamlprims specification revision 1.3, section 7.2, for these nodes only: omitted scalars; block scalars with no source content line (no line containing a byte other than ASCII space or tab), including those whose span is not zero-width at end of input; retained tag wrappers sharing such a scalar's span; and zero-width collections. Emptiness here is a property of the source, not of the decoded value: a keep-chomping block scalar with no content line can decode to line feeds, and a zero-width mapping can hold an entry. Spans of other nodes are not defined by this revision. A span is selected by document index and a path into the profile's value tree; a path ending at a tagged node selects the wrapper, and an inner step selects the tagged node's inner node.
rules.omitted-or-empty-scalar: A zero-width omitted scalar, or a block scalar with no source content line whose engine span is zero-width, is normalized when its engine marker directly follows line breaks, or follows only ASCII-space indentation on its line after line breaks: step over that indentation, then place the span before the immediately preceding line breaks. Spaces on an earlier blank line stop the move. The point never moves before the end of the preceding sibling, the end of its key (for a mapping value), or its collection's start.
rules.non-zero-width-block-scalar:
A block scalar with no source content line whose engine span is not zero-width, as at end of input, keeps the engine start and ends by the block scalar end rule: the end of the line containing its start. For example k: |

 and k: |
 both span [3, 4). The indicator is never recovered by scanning backward.
rules.tagged: A retained tag wrapper and its inner scalar share the scalar's span and move together.
rules.collection: A zero-width collection, including one wrapped in a retained tag, keeps its anchor; its wrapper and inner collection share it.
